user.title: Solar Accelerator Home - API Key
user.description:
Enter the API key generated in the SolarAccelerator panel.

This integration does NOT control the inverter — it only receives prices/profit from SolarAccelerator and registers accessories (EV chargers, controllable loads).

error.invalid_api_key_format: API key must start with 'sa_haapi_' and be at least 40 characters
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server
error.integration_disabled: Integration is disabled. Enable it in SolarAccelerator settings.

ev_charger.title: EV charger
ev_charger.description: Prefix is the Charge Point ID from the OCPP integration (entities sensor.{prefix}_...).

heat_pump.title: Heat pump
heat_pump.description: Choose how to fill in the entities. HeishaMon (Panasonic Aquarea): enter the entity prefix — we detect them and you can adjust each in the next step. Manual: pick the entities yourself. The pump is not controlled — the data feeds the consumption forecast and statistics.

data_description.prefix: Default panasonic_heat_pump (entities sensor.panasonic_heat_pump_main_…). Ignored in manual mode.

heat_pump_entities.title: Heat pump — entities
heat_pump_entities.description: Every field is optional — not every pump exposes everything. An empty field means that statistic will not be shown.

measurement.name: Consumption measurement
measurement.description: An external meter for the whole device is the most accurate (e.g. Shelly, 3-phase meter — pick 1–3 entities, they are summed). Without a meter we use power or the consumption reported by the pump.

modes.name: Operating modes (heating / hot water)

data.mode: Operating mode (entity/helper: co / cwu / defrost / off)

modes.description: Preferably consumption split into heating and hot water. If the pump does not expose it, create a helper returning co / cwu / defrost / off and use it as the operating mode.

season_defrost.name: Season and defrost
season_defrost.description: Season: an entity telling whether space heating is enabled (e.g. operating mode Heat+DHW vs DHW).

heat.name: Heat and water circuit
heat.description: Delivered heat lets us compute COP. Flow and temperatures — heat taken from the house by defrost.

compressor.name: Compressor and backup heater
compressor.description: Heater: an entity showing the heater is RUNNING — not that it is allowed.

settings.name: Controller settings

data.heater_on_outdoor_temp_c: Backup heater on below outdoor temp (°C)

settings.description: Heating curve and thresholds — compared with what the forecast learns.

error.prefix_not_found: No entities found with this prefix

options.manual: Manual — I will pick the entities
